description: When Weather Becomes a Problem: Motivating Resilience Action in Texas is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by City of San Angelo; Adaptation International; Institute for Social and Environmental Transition-International. In San Angelo, a focus on addressing current weather-related concerns provided an avenue for taking action and created a foundation on which to build future climate resilience efforts. Coverage: Texas (2017). The toolkit gives Texas as the location, 2017 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
